# GT Marketing

> GT Marketing is an Australian marketing agency based in Darwin, Northern Territory. It provides strategy, SEO, social media marketing, website development, hosting, email and direct outreach, automation, analytics and conversion optimisation.

- Canonical domain: https://gtmarketing.io

- The Vault: https://gtmarketing.io/the-vault
- Contact: https://gtmarketing.io/contact
- Privacy policy: https://gtmarketing.io/privacy

## Core services

- Marketing strategy and positioning
- Search engine optimisation and local SEO
- Social media marketing
- Direct-to-consumer marketing
- Website development and landing pages
- Web hosting
- Email and direct marketing outreach
- Marketing automation
- Analytics, reporting and conversion optimisation

## Industries served

GT Marketing develops marketing systems for tradies, hospitality businesses, NDIS providers, SMEs, agriculture, finance and crypto, real estate, security providers and events.
